issues.description: Element: expected output columns for Aufgabe 01. Problem statement (problem_statement.md line 18) requires the query to return Zoo.name, Zoo.url (Internetadresse), Gemeinde.name and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) returns only Zoo.name and Zoo.url AS Internetadresse and omits Gemeinde.name and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. The template (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql) returns Zoo.name and Gemeinde.name, omitting Zoo.url and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. This mismatch between the problem specification and the reference solution can confuse students about which columns are required and may cause automated checks to disagree with the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql so it returns exactly the columns requested by the problem statement. Example corrected query: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url AS Internetadresse, Gemeinde.name AS Gemeinde_name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo JOIN Gemeinde ON Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel; This aligns the reference solution with the task description and the intended join condition.
